thread.listingTitle: Small single room at Kangaroo Point, Brisbane

messages.text: Hi, I'm Dayeong Lee, a 26-year-old female interested in your room. I have 6 years of experience living in dorms and studios, so I'm very tidy and know how to take good care of a house. I'd like to arrange an inspection anytime after March 20th if possible. Please let me know when you're available. Looking forward to hearing from you!
